rows: - Tier run: black-box integration through a real socket against the production bundle: 5 files, 123 tests, all green (about 40 s); prettier, eslint and typecheck of the package clean. Worktree creation runs real git: a bare local repository stands in for GitHub through git's `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` `insteadOf` rewrite of the `https://x-access-token:<token>@github.com/` URL the service builds, so the service's own clone command runs unchanged. The diff store is read from, and seeded into, the throwaway HOME, so the on-disk format is pinned too.
